item.description: Antiquity of the Śivasūtras: Phylogenetic Constraints on the Vowel and Consonant Inventory Abstract The phonological distinctions in the vowel section of the Śivasūtras indicate articulatory capabilities distinct from those of anatomically modern humans.

item.title: What we know about speech of Shiv
item.description: Known facts There was high nasalisation Tonal manipulations were absent Breath control was rudimentary or absent.

item.title: पूर्व
item.description: पुर्वँ = प उ र व चंद्र बिंदी roped up a superior person pull धातु अर्थ at पुरण = पूर् + ल्युट् = satisfy originally by drinking water रूढ अर्थ First, from completed/fulfilled.

item.title: पूर्
item.description: पूरीँ = प उ र इ चंद्र बिंदी rope up water below pull धातु अर्थ at आप्यायन = आ + प्याय् + ल्युट् satisfaction, hence to complete.

item.title: प्याय्
item.description: ओँप्यायीँ = ओ म् प य य आ य इ चंद्र बिंदी detach/from inside rope connect upto connect below inside धातु अर्थ at वृद्ध = वृध् + क्त grow (with irrigation indicated by वृध्), prosper and hence satisfy The emaning is added to धातु पाठ later on.

item.title: वृध्
item.description: वृधुँ = व ऋ ध उ चंद्र बिंदी person superior carry उ as क्रियापद विभक्ति pull = means to grow Speech superior carry उ as क्रियापद विभक्ति outside = eans to speak धातु अर्थ circular reference to itself at भाषा = stand upto pointed upto = instructing = speaking रूढ अर्थ to increase, grow prosper speak.
